title: Contextual Moral Value Alignment Through Context-Based Aggregation
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on general moral values such as authority, fairness, sanctity, care, and loyalty, without connecting them to a religious context.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion.
